verdict.rationale: Circle's docs show extensive REST APIs, SDKs, CLI, and even an MCP server covering wallets, CCTP, compliance screening, and payments—suggesting an API-first product where most console functionality is scriptable. However, there is no explicit statement that every UI/Console action has a 1:1 API equivalent, and the openapi.json probe returned 404s, weakening confidence in complete machine-readable API coverage. Missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity documentation, evidence that Console-only features (e.g. account settings, dashboards) are also API-accessible, and independent confirmation of full parity.
